leaps-*.json, leaps-*.yml, leaps-*.txt: trimmed from Leaps in Bounds (https://leapsinbounds.org,
https://github.com/daniel-munro/leaps-in-bounds), MIT License, Copyright (c) 2025 Daniel Munro.
The WS(6) >= 650 colouring is S. E. Rodrigo's (2026), as held in that repository.

Every other file here is written for these tests in the same layout as its source (B. Dobbelaere's pages, A. E.
Brouwer's table and code files, an OEIS entry); the values in them are made up or are small textbook objects.
